name: White on White

authors.name: Operation Coinnectar Crew (HaxNation x FOSS Mumbai 2026)

description:
An “Architecture Overview” diagram was recovered from the contributor's laptop. It renders as a tidy box-and-arrow sketch — but a .excalidraw file is just JSON, and not everything in it is meant to be seen.

Recover the secret the file carries.
hints: What renders on the canvas and what's stored in the file are not the same thing. Look for an element you can't see.
